name: remove-viewed-commit-badge
goal: History rows highlight the selected commit without showing a redundant Viewed commit badge.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Acceptance: remove the redundant Viewed commit pill from entity history rows while preserving the selected row highlight; applies to all entity history pages.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Coverage gap: entity-history.test.ts asserts Viewed commit is present; harness-explorer-routes.spec.ts redirects the legacy history URL to the service history page but checks only its URL. Extend that existing route flow with absence and selected-row assertions after a screenshot checkpoint.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At failing-test commit be264503, Playwright service-history route failed the unchanged badge assertion: expected 0, received 1. The checkpoint screenshot shows Viewed commit beside the selected service commit while the viewed row highlight remains.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: The regression commits the exact history row behavior: remove the conditional badge, retain the viewed row class, and revise the EntityHistoryRow contract accordingly.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged Playwright route regression passed at fix commit adefacdc1 with the row still highlighted and no Viewed commit badge.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: At rebased fix commit 7e0c06ebc (tree a38d93ff, identical to fully checked merge tree), root formatting/type/lint/kernel, 917 unit tests (25 skipped), 69 root E2E files (231 passed), builds, package checks, Harness audit/registry, reports, planning (50), and desktop non-E2E checks passed. The pre-sync root chain was interrupted when its old Desktop E2E default started; after syncing main at 8d779bcb, desktop test:e2e passed 200/200 Chromium tests, with collaboration (45), hub (477), remote (135), relay (159), root audit, and units check passing separately. Fresh unchanged regression proof: red at b18d5b6fe, green at 7e0c06ebc. AgentActivityService browser check showed zero badges, one highlighted row, and no page or console errors; screenshot inspected.
